biotools.summary: mariner is an R/Bioconductor package for exploring Hi-C data that provides functions for manipulating, extracting, and aggregating chromatin interaction data. It simplifies the process of querying and extracting contacts from multiple Hi-C files and enables complete analysis and visualization of Hi-C data in R.
